title: Conversation event (conversations/{conversationId}/{eventId}.json)
description: Append-only bridge-owned remote-thread event. Immutable once written; corrections are new events referencing the original commandId. The thread is reproducible from protocol data: command and response events reference their protocol files by commandId instead of duplicating content. Spec section 8.1.

eventId.description: ULID. Unique and time-sortable. The stream is ordered by eventId.

commandId.description: For command/response events: the protocol file holding the content (commands/inbox or responses).

driveItemId.description: OneDrive driveItem reference; artifacts are referenced by ID, never inlined (spec 11.1).

attentionReason.description: For attention events: exactly what the user must do on the desktop.
